ai_summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited announced a key leadership transition, with Mr. Kalpesh Patel ceasing as Chief Operating Officer (COO) due to health reasons. The company has promptly appointed Mr. Ashwani Saraf, a highly experienced manufacturing operations leader with over 30 years in relevant sectors and significant P&L accountability, as the new COO. This swift and qualified succession plan mitigates potential operational disruption, and the stated reason for the outgoing COO's departure does not raise immediate red flags.
